item.title: Shubman Gill set to play two Vijay Hazare Trophy games for Punjab; likely to play Ranji Trophy as well- Report
item.description: Shubman Gill, India’s ODI and Test captain, has confirmed his availability to the Punjab Cricket Association (PCA) for two games of the upcoming Vijay Hazare Trophy 2025 one-day tournament. The VHT 2025 will begin on December 24. Shubman Gill will have time till the New Zealand ODI series that begins on January 11, after he was unceremoniously dropped from India’s T20I squad for the New Zealand T20Is and the T20 World Cup 2026 tournament. item.title: “Why did he say that?”- Rohit Sharma reveals how Tim Paine’s ‘Gabba’ jibe fueled India’s Brisbane miracle in BGT 2020-21
item.description: During India's 2020/21 trip of Australia, former captain Rohit Sharma recalled the historic Gabba Test win. India, without skipper Virat Kohli, were the first visiting team to win a Test at the venue in 32 years. Australia was undefeated in 31 games at the Gabba. India entered the series decider in Brisbane without several important players, but managed to pull off the unbelievable, winning their second consecutive Test series in Australia. item.title: Ravindra Jadeja pushes for 2027 World Cup by making himself available for Saurashtra in Vijay Hazare Trophy matches
item.description: Veteran India all-rounder Ravindra Jadeja has confirmed his availability for Saurashtra in the 2025-26 Vijay Hazare Trophy season, set to begin on December 24. According to a TOI report, Jadeja will likely feature in the country’s premier domestic 50-over tournament on January 6 and January 8 against Services and Gujarat, respectively, with both fixtures to be stage in Alur, Karnataka. item.title: “It is like choosing Srikkanth over Gavaskar,” WV Raman bemused by Shubman Gill’s T20 World Cup omission
item.description: Shubman Gill was the notable omission from India’s T20 World Cup 2026 squad announced on Saturday (December 20). He looked to be a sure-shot for the marquee event after his return to the format and being given vice-captaincy and the opener's role. However, the 26-year-old struggled to make an impact with the bat, scoring 291 runs in 15 matches at an average of 24.25 and a strike-rate of 137.26. item.title: “Proven match-winner in T20s,” Kaif explains why Suryakumar Yadav deserves extra backing compared to Shubman Gill
item.description: Shubman Gill, who was recalled to the T20I set-up as vice-captain ahead of the Asia Cup, has been left out of India’s squad for the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026, to be played in India and Sri Lanka from February 7 to March 8. item.title: Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma’s return to Vijay Hazare Trophy won’t be live-streamed or telecasted due to BCCI’s limitations- Report
item.description: Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma, two of India's best batsmen, will play again on Wednesday for Delhi and Mumbai, respectively, in the first round of the Vijay Hazare Trophy 2025-26. While Rohit last participated in the competition in 2018, Kohli will be making his maiden appearance in the domestic List A event in fifteen years. item.title: WATCH: Axar Patel recalls Virat Kohli’s viral “Baapu tari bowling kamal che” praise for him after 2021 pink-ball Test
item.description: India all-rounder Axar Patel revisited one of his most memorable on-field moments with Virat Kohli, a video of which continues to resurface on social media. The clip dates back to the 2021 pink-ball Test against England in Ahmedabad, where Axar wreaked havoc with the ball across two innings. He claimed six wickets in the first innings and followed it up with five scalps. His 11-wicket match haul propelled India to a dominant victory and earned him the Player-of-the-Match award. item.title: WATCH: “He will also have to modify his game,” Amit Mishra warns Rishabh Pant after poor show in South Africa series
item.description: Former India spinner Amit Mishra has advised Rishabh Pant to modify his batting style to maintain his place in the Test side. item.title: “Frontrunner was forgotten,” Aakash Chopra questions Yashasvi Jaiswal’s T20 World Cup 2026 non-selection
item.description: Former cricketer-turned-commentator Aakash Chopra has expressed disappointment over Yashasvi Jaiswal’s non-selection in India’s T20 World Cup 2026 squad. Chopra also reminded that the left-handed opener was part of the T20 World Cup-winning Indian team in 2024.
